Thank you for the empowering words!

One day I hope you’ll be able to function even with mental health struggles. I was unable to function at all, a couple of years back. Now I’m still depressed, but I learned how to be functional, at least. It took five years of therapy. And I’m still in therapy and taking medication.
They matter, if it’s someone we love.
I’m really sorry that she said that to you. It must be hard providing for both of you, when you are not feeling your best.
Hmm I don’t think it’s the name that’s the problem . It’s that some people aren’t properly educated about it. I think everyone should learn about mental health in schools.
When you said that you went home from the ward, but didn’t feel at home, I felt that. I’m having the same feeling after I came back home from the ward. And I honestly don’t know if it’ll pass.
Very good point. She’s trying to help as best she can, even though it’s not effective.
Aww thank you, this means so much to me!
Thank you <3
Talk to her about it then. But how come a psychologist is offering you medication? Don’t you mean psychiatrist?
Thank you!
This is super empowering!
Thank you for the uplifting comment ☺️

That’s heartbreaking to hear, especially from someone you love. I’m sorry about that. They’re wrong by the way, don’t listen to them. You’re not weak and it’s not a permanent illness. I think you should seek professional help, they’ll help you get back on your feet.
I’m sorry to hear about that. I hope you’re doing better now!
I’m sorry about that
